locationPrivacy: Do not place an actual private address, coordinates, parcel identifier, access credential, or sensitive security detail in this repository. Keep controlled evidence externally and record only a non-sensitive reference after owner review.
provenance: All entries are AI-authored requests for real-site evidence. Nulls are intentional; no real-world site data or physical validation exists.

legalLocation.reason: A privately controlled legal address and coordinate reference are needed for jurisdiction, survey, flood, utility, emergency, and design review; actual private location must not be collected in this public repository.

jurisdictionPermitting.reason: Identify every AHJ, adopted code, zoning/planning constraint, permit, inspection, utility approval, and underground-structure requirement before design or work.

propertyAuthorization.reason: Document ownership, easements, boundaries, rights of entry, neighbor constraints, and written authorization for investigation and any future work.

geotechnicalReport.reason: A qualified geotechnical investigation must establish subsurface profiles, strength, stiffness, variability, bearing, uplift, settlement, constructability, and design recommendations.

soilClassification.reason: Soil classification for excavation safety must be performed by the required competent person using actual conditions; geotechnical labels alone are not an excavation protective-system selection.

groundwater.reason: Measured seasonal groundwater and perched-water conditions are required for excavation stability, dewatering assessment, buoyancy, durability, and waterproofing design.

drainageFlooding.reason: Establish surface-water paths, lawful discharge, flood history/modeling, backflow, pump dependence, blockage and power-loss consequences without assuming a drain outlet exists.

utilitiesOfficialLocates.reason: Obtain current official locates and utility-owner coordination for all buried and overhead services, then positively identify conflicts by approved means before ground disturbance.

surveyControl.reason: A qualified survey must establish boundaries, topography, benchmarks, control, existing features, drainage levels, and later as-built verification in a documented datum.

accessTransport.reason: Assess legal transport, delivery, crane and concrete access, ground bearing, overhead conflicts, temporary works, emergency access, and bystander/exclusion-zone constraints.

environmentalArchaeological.reason: Complete required environmental, heritage/archaeological, ecological, erosion, spoil and waste assessments and define stop-work/notification responsibilities.

radonMethaneContamination.reason: Assess radon, methane, other hazardous gases, contaminated soil/water and legacy uses so entry, ventilation, waste and material decisions use real evidence.

climateFloodFreeze.reason: Obtain jurisdiction-approved rainfall, flood, temperature, freeze/thaw, frost and climate exposures for siting, earthworks, concrete, durability and maintenance design.

seismicWindSnow.reason: Obtain applicable seismic, wind, snow and related environmental design actions and site coefficients from adopted code and qualified engineering review.

fireEmergency.reason: Determine fire-service access, water/suppression strategy, alarms, responder communication, rescue constraints, emergency contacts and local emergency-planning obligations.

structuralLoads.reason: Define equipment, storage, maintenance, vehicle, construction, soil, hydrostatic, uplift, impact, thermal, shrinkage and environmental load combinations for released structural design.

protectiveSystemDesign.reason: Provide site-specific engineered sloping, benching, shoring, shielding or other protective systems, adjacent-structure assessment, access and inspection criteria; the CAD envelope is not this design.

egressOccupancy.reason: Confirm non-habitable use and determine lawful maintenance access, travel distances, exits, door hardware, entrapment prevention, accessibility and rescue requirements without assuming one opening is adequate.

applicableCode.reason: Create a current-edition code and standards matrix covering building, structural, geotechnical, excavation, electrical, mechanical, fire, energy, accessibility, environmental and worker safety requirements.

existingConditionsDocumentation.reason: Collect controlled photographs, records, prior drawings, monitoring and nearby-structure condition information needed to establish the baseline without exposing private data publicly.
